description: An assessor is due at the Ward Nine permits window at some point today and doesn't intend to spend her morning standing in a corridor. You will. That's the job and Halcyon isn't embarrassed about it.
name: Place Held

objectives.desc: Hold a place in the permits queue until the assessor arrives.
emotes: {who} shuffles forward one place in ninety minutes.
{who} is asked twice what they're queuing for and doesn't know either time.
